excluded.reason: Task's initial Saturn-mosaic guess was wrong: the real 'Day the Earth Smiled' mosaic is PIA17172 (verified via NASA API + JPL page). PIA11141 not selected.
Task's alternate Saturn guess is actually Mars: NASA API title is 'Nirgal Vallis'. Excluded as wrong subject.
Task's Enceladus guess is actually Mars: NASA API title is 'The Contrasting Colors of Crater Dunes and Gullies'. Excluded as wrong subject; PIA17202 used instead.
Task's Rhea/Tethys guess is a Saturn rings view: NASA API title is 'Planet Six'. Excluded as wrong subject; PIA17155 (Rhea) and PIA07733 (Tethys) used instead.
Task's Dione guess is Mimas: NASA API title is 'Color Near Herschel Crater'. Excluded as wrong subject; PIA19653 used instead.
Task's Iapetus guess is Earth: NASA API title is 'Northern Greenland'. Excluded as wrong subject; PIA11690 used instead.

variant_notes: images-assets.nasa.gov serves ~orig/~medium/~small variants per asset; missing variants return HTTP 403, so only 200-verified variants are listed above.
